name: drawio-skill
tagline_zh: 你说架构、流程图、UML，它直接出图——连K8s清单都能变拓扑。不写一行代码，白板秒变工程图。
tagline_en: From chat to diagram: UML, BPMN, even K8s to topology. No code, just draw.
desc_en: Use when the user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams, UML / sequence / class diagrams, SysML / MBSE diagrams (block definition, internal block, requirement, parametric), BPMN business process diagrams, swimlane / cross-functional flowcharts, network topology, cloud architecture from Terraform or Kubernetes manifests, ML/DL model figures (Transformer/CNN/LSTM), mind m
why_zh: 同类只会画固定模板，它能解析Terraform和K8s清单生成云架构，还支持SysML和ML模型图。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it parses Terraform/K8s for cloud diagrams and covers SysML & ML figures.
